fusions.name: Hidden Spur
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that snaps a hidden spur from the hilt, which deals 30 damage, always crits, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinwheel Cutters
fusions.desc: A sprung fan throws 3 blades that each deal 6 damage, with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Stropping Spindle
fusions.desc: Runs your edges over a spinning strop, raising your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring-Loaded Edge
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, a concealed edge springs out: your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
